definitions.explanation: One of the five digits on the hand or foot.

examples.japanese: {右手|みぎて}の{人差し指|ひとさしゆび}が{痛|いた}い。
{子供|こども}が{指|ゆび}で{数|かず}を{数|かぞ}えている。
examples.english: The child is counting numbers on their fingers.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}をしていて{指|ゆび}を{切|き}ってしまったので、{絆創膏|ばんそうこう}を{貼|は}った。
examples.english: I cut my finger while cooking, so I put on a bandage.

notes:
{指|ゆび} refers to both fingers and toes. For toes specifically, use {足|あし}の{指|ゆび}.

INDIVIDUAL FINGERS:
- {親指|おやゆび}: thumb
- {人差|ひとさ}し{指|ゆび}: index finger
- {中指|なかゆび}: middle finger
- {薬指|くすりゆび}: ring finger
- {小指|こゆび}: little finger, pinky

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {指|ゆび}を{切|き}る: to cut one's finger
- {指|ゆび}を{さす|さす}: to point at
- {指輪|ゆびわ}: ring (jewelry)
- {指先|ゆびさき}: fingertip

IDIOM:
- {指|ゆび}をくわえる: to look on enviously (literally: to suck one's finger)
